title: Panda with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='20' fill='#f4f4f8'/>
  <!-- arms -->
  <ellipse cx='27' cy='70' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#5a4f7a' transform='rotate(18 27 70)'/>
  <ellipse cx='73' cy='70' rx='7' ry='12' fill='#5a4f7a' transform='rotate(-18 73 70)'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='89' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#5a4f7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='89' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#5a4f7a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='38' r='27' fill='#f8f8fc'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='29' cy='17' r='9' fill='#5a4f7a'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='17' r='9' fill='#5a4f7a'/>
  <circle cx='29' cy='17' r='4.5' fill='#8a7bb0'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='17' r='4.5' fill='#8a7bb0'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='37' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#5a4f7a' transform='rotate(-15 38 37)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='37' rx='10' ry='12' fill='#5a4f7a' transform='rotate(15 62 37)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='39' r='3.5' fill='#2a2440'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='39' r='3.5' fill='#2a2440'/>
  <!-- sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx='36.5' cy='37' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='37' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='39.5' cy='41' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63.5' cy='41' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- little sparkle stars -->
  <path d='M24 46 l1.3 3 3 1.3 -3 1.3 -1.3 3 -1.3 -3 -3 -1.3 3 -1.3 z' fill='#bfe9ff'/>
  <path d='M76 30 l1.3 3 3 1.3 -3 1.3 -1.3 3 -1.3 -3 -3 -1.3 3 -1.3 z' fill='#bfe9ff'/>
  <path d='M50 12 l1.2 2.6 2.6 1.2 -2.6 1.2 -1.2 2.6 -1.2 -2.6 -2.6 -1.2 2.6 -1.2 z' fill='#ffe9a8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a3252'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 54 q4 4 8 0' stroke='#3a3252' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='3.5' fill='#ffb3c6' opacity='0.85'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
